subject.title: Feature: Reminders tab in Mission Control

question: Should reminder separation be implemented as a typed cron purpose/display metadata contract with a dedicated Reminders route, or should it wait behind the broader cron tags/categories API?
rationale: The remaining work crosses persisted cron state, Gateway protocol validation, service filtering, reminder-producing paths, and Control UI behavior, so maintainers need to choose the durable API/display shape before an implementation PR.

options.title: Typed purpose/display metadata
options.body: Add a narrow cron purpose/display contract for reminders and other first-party scheduled-job UI, then build the Reminders tab on that contract.

options.title: General tags first
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/53107 the primary design and implement Reminders only after freeform tags/categories are accepted.

options.title: Keep Cron-only UI
options.body: Avoid a separate tab and improve Cron filters/copy only, accepting that reminders remain part of the generic scheduled-job list.

recommendation.title: Typed purpose/display metadata
recommendation.body: Add a narrow cron purpose/display contract for reminders and other first-party scheduled-job UI, then build the Reminders tab on that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He already made the owner-review call on the prior cron metadata PR and is tied to adjacent cron protocol/list history.
